verdict.rationale: Exa's own Websets API works across many items at once: a Webset takes a target item count, verifies every result against criteria, and fills enrichment fields for each accepted item, with HTTP callbacks as items are added or enriched (exa-docs-28, exa-docs-8, exa-docs-21). Exa Agent also offers list building and entity enrichment from a single API (exa-docs-26). Hands-on reports show an enrichment column failing to fill across results and bulk verification stalling on 'Verifying...' (exa-comm-2, exa-comm-3), which caps quality but does not concretely refute the capability. Missing for 10: documented batch operations beyond Websets enrichment (e.g., bulk update/delete or batch Contents/Search requests), documented per-request item limits, and independent confirmation that bulk enrichment works reliably at scale.
